posts.author: EbonSkolli
posts.body:
I just finished another plugin. I know there's a few of these parameter growth rate plugins out there, but I wanted to try to make my own. Originally, I was trying to make it so you could additionally effect EX and SP parameters on level-up, but I couldn't get that part working. So, this one only works with basic parameters. If I can get it to work properly with the other parameter types, I'll post an update.
HOW TO USE:
This plugin uses notetags in the Classes tab. Copy and paste the example from the
@Help
section, then modify the number values. The first number value is the percent chance of getting +1 to a stat; the second number value is a percent chance of getting a +2 to a stat (fun bonus for players).
For base stats, just enter those in the database like you normally would when making a class. Just make sure you use the Generate Curve setting and set the level 1 and 99 values to the same number for each parameter. Otherwise, it will stack with the notetag settings.
TERMS OF USE:
Use for commercial or non-commercial projects. Please credit EbonSkolli if you use this plugin.
